owner: Exact active doodesch.multiplayer native plugin and its registered session provider
thread: Bound game thread; callbacks must not block

bind.effect: Retain the supplied callbacks and arm initialization; do not load a world or advance a tick
bind.requires: Exact draft, sized structs, owner, provider, session and fixed dt

activate.effect: Activate a held session after verified bootstrap and peer agreement
activate.requires: Current lease, world epoch, snapshot identity and initial witness

read.effect: Copy the retained local receipt without a native call or replay
read.requires: Current lease and a sufficiently sized output

unbind.effect: Retire callbacks when no invocation still owns them
unbind.requires: Keep callback and user storage alive while BUSY

preflight_exit.effect: Read admission for an explicit local exit; does not itself quit
preflight_exit.requires: Current held or failed service, owner, lease and bound thread

snapshot.effect: Prepare, seal, capture, pump, publish and release an ordered snapshot through distinct operations
snapshot.requires: Exact held boundary, certificate, completed native writer and required peer/file acknowledgements

exit_save.effect: Retain a healthy Quit Save intent or an explicit terminal/reload retirement scope; does not call original Quit
exit_save.requires: Exact lease, phase, owner and matching publication/retirement acknowledgement

rules: Next is borrowed for one invocation and one native attempt; never retain or retry it after failure or timeout
A missing provider or stale acknowledgement grants no world-write authority
A failed service can maintain local UI and perform admitted retirement without advancing simulation or clearing the original failure
Native async Save completion and companion/peer publication are separate acknowledgements
This native extension adds no Lua functions or local-mod write permissions
ARM_PERIODIC 7 preserves the exact original Host periodic Save purpose; only its confirmed released certificate may complete a retained Client periodic UI request
